name: Fire Guard
tagline: A helmet-mounted system that maps rooms through smoke with camera and LiDAR and relays it to command.
problem: Firefighters navigate smoke-filled buildings with poor visibility and communication, the team says.
solution: YOLO detection fuses camera and LiDAR to find doors and obstacles, an LLM classifies rooms, radar and IMU sensors add tracking, and live data streams to a command dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: walk a room and see detected objects on the command map.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Built from a past volunteer firefighter's experience.

lessons: Sensor fusion shows depth when one sensor fails and another covers.
